verdict.rationale: Motion publishes a live llms.txt at usemotion.com/llms.txt that serves agent-oriented plain-text content (product overview, use cases, pricing), confirmed by runtime probe, plus a documented API reference with working auth that an agent could consume. Missing for 10: llms.txt is only on the marketing origin (docs.usemotion.com does not serve one), and the llms.txt content is marketing-oriented rather than deep technical/API guidance for agents.
